name: Darkstar Hubble
quote: The light of dimming stars sings a solitary lullaby.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Has the light of dawn always glared as such? ...Right, you are approaching gravitational collapse, too. In that very moment, you, too, will certainly be very, very bright...

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: The starlight... is not gone, 'tis only covered by the light of another fiercely burning star... man looks towards the stars oft, why does their sight fail to stay upon the star nearest to them?

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Celestial bodies are bound to march towards destruction and chaos, and stars rush towards death in all their fiery glory. I, in the past, overlooked that process of annihilation of my own accord. All along, that was the finest chapter of their epic...

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Stars shine with such brilliance because they burn their very selves away. How beautiful... if one were to wish upon it, would they too, meet annihilation?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Did you know that the sky has always been pitch black? The supposed light of day is nothing more than gas and dust, responding to a star's presence. So, Professor—would you have finite light, or boundless darkness? Hehe... of course, you need not answer me right now.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: When we encounter a star, we are naturally attracted. When a star reaches its end, and their gravity grows greater, and greater... Starcrumbs shall encircle you, until you are back by my side.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Sinking into a collapsed dream, the descent ever so sweet—o stars, fade along with me...

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Where are you going? Will you sweep away those crumbs of stars? The clouds of stardust are endless. Your task is not one that can be finished. Though... if you will go, then I shall follow you.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: The skies... grow deeper in color.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Hehehe... come a little closer. I will not disintegrate so soon.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Can you see it, Professor? That rust-red planet.

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Please leave it to me, just like before.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: You are... the Professor? Thank goodness I'm by your side again. Seems that for the sake of this moment, I've been lost amongst the stars for far too long. I've even almost forgotten this name, "Hubble"...

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: Can a lost future... be found again?

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Consuming others to fill the void... one day, I will meet such an end too...

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: The firmament turns as the celestial stream surges, and all matter rides it unto destruction. Please, witness the end of time by my side.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Shall you guide me back onto the correct orbit?

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Let us clear away the fragments in our way.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Not even light shall escape!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Can lost memories... be inscribed into the scars?

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: The black hole shall devour all, sooner or later.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: The nebulae... wither...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: I seem to have... forgotten no small amount of things... but the stars that shine above at this moment, and your presence in front of me, remain embedded deep in my neural cloud. For us to meet again must doubtlessly be the will of some divinity in the great unknown. If you would risk the very stars around us disintegrating, then come—I shall be one with you. We will be together, for eternity.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: An... agreement we made on a New Year? Ah, I remember now. I promised I would teach you how to read the stars. You really do remember these things well, Professor. If that's the case, even if I were to be lost amongst the stars again... you'd find me again, no? Hehe... I shall uphold my promise, then. Even if we did lose a year between us, I will teach you, Just like this, on and on—

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: Professor, I made starlight chocolates for you. I've done that before? No, it's different this time—this one's you, this one's me. For a star's light to be reflected, another must be present. If the present me still shines in your eyes... then it must be because you yourself are brilliant beyond belief. When one puts it that way, you shall be the one that collapse finds last... hehe, will you tear me apart and suck me in? Sounds romantic.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: Shall I tell you that story about that loving pair? Right... the thing stopping them from meeting was the great wide galaxy itself. For me, though, the galaxy lit the path towards you... the stars shall not keep us apart. If any shard dares to impede me, they shall be crushed, and made to pave my road towards you. Upon their remnant glimmers I shall walk, until I am by your side...

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Halloween's stars sparkle as always... but, with how I am now, do I truly need any special ornamentation for Halloween? Hehe... I think it quite beautiful, to be like this. Seeing as you are by my side, Professor, you don't mind it that much, right? Why don't we become alike... come on. When that time comes, the skies shall be exceedingly vivid, and confectionaries extraordinarily sweet...

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: A witch of the holy night, borne on a broom of comet, flitting across the sky with presents in tow... scattered wishes hanging upon the tips of branches, descending with ice and snow before a home's hearth... just when did these things come to pass? I think I hear familiar music besides me... my head hurts a little. It seems I've forgotten something important. Let's open the present I have for you, Professor—eh? There are presents for me, too? From whom, I wonder...

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Happy birthday, Professor. This is one of a few things I do remember well. I've prepared a present, so I'll need you to cover your eyes—dark, isn't it? Just like space. In truth... light discernable to the human eye is very limited. Even a place that appears dark is filled with light that the eye cannot capture. You can't make out what's in the darkness, can you, Professor? I can. Just follow me, in this world where only you cannot see, moving forward step by step... hehehe, relax. We will end it at the presents today.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text:
Mm... mmm...
...Oh, did I fall asleep again? I just had a dream. I dreamt of—rusted brown-red shades, an endless song... and I saw... your silhouette, drifting further and further away, brilliant gems scattered across the realm... what a marvelous dreamscape. One can hardly bring themselves to look away. Professor, tell me... is the end of a star another form of eternal sleep?

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
Can I stay lucid? It's a more difficult task than before, I must admit. Sleep and stupor are growing more difficult for me to distinguish between...
Worried about me? Do not be, Professor. I feel perfectly well... black holes and tears in reality frighten me no more, and the world itself glistens like the nebulae. The starcrumbs known as Entropy flow and weave, calling me towards them... ephemeral, silent, yet fantastical.
Would you like to gaze into my world?

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
Taking me to observe the stars? What nostalgia this summons. Just what have I cast away? I struggle to remember.
The faraway stars are beautiful, no? Yet they lie so far away... each and every strand of light they send forth must cross a gap of a thousand million light-years. Not unlike me, unknowing of when I would return... That was an agonizing and burdensome time indeed, but if I slowly think back to the place where each and every star belongs, I find it in myself to be calm. To... bear the pain a little better.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
Did you know, Professor? Those stars I pointed out to you most likely died out many, many years ago. What we see is but... the remnant light of a now extinct mass. Hmm—you think it's unfortunate? I think it's mesmerizing... each and every star advances towards annihilation, and every beam of light has its end. How are you to know, then, that I am not the remnants of something already dead?
Hehe... seems I've made you worry again. Fret not, I am still here... at least for now.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
This telescope... wow, to think that you still have it. I thought it went the way of the observatory, destroyed long ago. Allow me to make some adjustments... see, starlight from eons ago has finally arrived. Even if its original recipient had no doubt ceased to be many years ago too. Forlorn, yet so magnificent... no matter, let us receive these gifts in their place. A journey's end need not be what was originally intended, and things are lovely as they are, no? ...So, will you leave behind your work here, and fly away with me into the serene darkness, where we may gaze at the stars?
...Found me out, have you? Hehe... then we shall proceed as you desire, and continue with you leading me in my orbit. Until you are tired enough to hand everything over to me...

voices.label: Understanding
voices.text: I understand.

voices.label: Agreement
voices.text: I see.

voices.label: Sympathy
voices.text: Hmm.

voices.label: Dissatisfied
voices.text: Hmm...

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Hehe

voices.label: Live2D1
voices.text: If you would risk the very stars around us disintegrating, then come—I shall be one with you. We will be together, for eternity.

voices.label: Live2D2
voices.text: ...Oh, did I fall asleep again? I seem to have... forgotten no small amount of things...If you would risk the very stars around us disintegrating, then come—I shall be one with you. We will be together, for eternity.

career:
The first Doll of the PSRA Model—Hubble, originally a Doll designed by 42Lab for the purposes of astronomy research, was recommended for Project Neural Cloud. After Magrasea was affected by Entropic infestation, Hubble has displayed a series of traits and tendencies distinct from her original inclinations.

After Entropization, Hubble has become affected by phenomena such as scrambled memory data and neural disruptions. Her modus operandi and thought processes have turned towards that of an "Entropic", which is comparatively unstable and dangerous. However, her core code and combat abilities may be of great assistance to the Oasis. After intense analysis and risk assessments, PSRA has rejoined the Oasis under a new codename, "Darkstar Hubble".
infoStories:
Darkstar Hubble's appearance was facilitated by the choices she made in "Jiutian", the Space Sector. During the Operation in Jiutian, Hubble decided to preserve the data of the agents present in the Sector via self-sacrifice. After a series of exploration and rescue missions, the Oasis discovered Hubble, who had survived and was living under the identity of an Entropic in Jiutian, and successfully retrieved her.

In accordance to the Entropized Hubble's interpretation of self and other needs, her logged name has been changed to "Darkstar Hubble". Since her arrival at the Oasis, the Medical and Technological Departments have conducted multiple studies on her. The results indicate that unlike other agents whose Entropization must be suppressed, Darkstar Hubble's Entropization is complete both structurally and fundamentally. As she exists now, she is doubtlessly a true "Entropic". Due to this, her identity and assignment have yet to be decided at the Oasis.

The difference between Darkstar Hubble and a normal agent extends beyond the results of examination. Whether it is her actions, habits, or her internal thought processes, she is starkly different compared to other Dolls and agents.

Based on her neural cloud evaluations, the way to describe the state of it is chaos; with data belonging to an Entropic and a Doll crisscrossing and reaching some form of equilibrium. Whether it's Antonina, who holds significant understanding of Entropics, or the otherwise experienced medical Dolls, no one can easily work with and adjust her neural processes. As the risk of whether an external hand would result in grievous effects on her neural cloud is one that none wish to take, the Medical Department's file on her neural health remains in a very rudimentary state.

Due to her unique identity and constitution, her existence remains one of the Oasis' best kept secrets. As Darkstar Hubble is not inclined towards making contact with others, many of the Oasis' agents have little understanding of her past and how she came to be.

Differing from the "Entropics" commonly seen in Magrasea, the root of Hubble's Entropization is the "Heat Death Entropics" who came into existence as the whole of Jiutian sought to complete their research. As a unique subspecies of Entropics, their composition differs in select places while remaining largely similar to other Entropics.

With Antonina's efforts and Hubble's cooperation, the Oasis has completed its analysis of her Entropic Core, and completed the risk neutralization procedures relevant to her. The infective nature and hostile tendencies native to Entropics have been effectively suppressed, and converted into a part of the energy source required to keep her conscious. As observed and tested, damage inflicted by Darkstar Hubble will not induce Entropic infection, avoiding possible friendly fire situations. After these procedures, she was released from quarantine, and began to participate in some day-to-day routine and combat operations.

Additionally, the Oasis' study of Entropics has been accelerated by Darkstar Hubble's cooperation, and the understanding of Entropics has advanced greatly in many aspects, including suppression and prevention. However, in regards to the "Entropics" themselves, many questions are yet to be answered.

Even if she has been of great help to the Oasis, Darkstar still recognizes herself as an "Entropic", not an "Agent infected by Entropy". As Jiutian's dilemma with the Heath Death Entropics has already been resolved, Darkstar Hubble stands alone as Magrasea's last existing Heat Death Entropic. She does not adhere to a greater mind or higher order of Entropic, being a unique individual with both agency and self-determination instead.

She remains a portion of memories from before Entropization, but Darkstar Hubble cannot easily access this memory data, and occasionally suffers mild headaches due to conflicting data. She continues to see herself as a researcher of astronomy, and still harbors a deep passion for the relevant fields, even if her perception and assessment of the same things have now largely changed.

After reasonable steps were taken to suppress her Entropic instincts, Darkstar Hubble's inclinations towards destruction and infection have reduced noticeably, but her thought processes as an Entropic remain the same. She often observes the actions of other agents from far away, comparing the difference in mannerisms between Entropics and Agents, without any intention of socializing with those individuals. An unexpected development, however, is that Darkstar Hubble appears largely supportive of "resetting Hubble"—it was gathered that this is due to an intense curiosity towards the version of her "self" that was an agent.

After restructuring alongside restraining her Entropic Core, Darkstar Hubble's combat capabilities cannot be compared to what she possessed when she was first Entropized. Her operands are supplied by the Oasis, the precise amount of which is determined by the Professor. With regards to the restrictions placed on her, Darkstar Hubble does not express aversion or resistance, instead seeming almost humored in her demeanor. She has very little need for socialization, but is very intimate to those with the permissions necessary to make contact with her—especially the Professor and Fresnel, being cordial and talkative towards them.

The pacification procedures the Medical Department had prepared went largely unused, but the records of her behavioral patterns drew no small amount of attention. Analysis indicates that she has attempted on many occasions to imply, insinuate, or otherwise communicate a desire to Entropize to the other party.

Though procedures to control Darkstar Hubble are available, one viewpoint stands fast amongst the members of the Medical Department: Darkstar Hubble's cooperation and provided assistance comes from her own will instead of any intrinsic, internal restrictions. When something drastic arises, she may very well remove her the limits placed upon her through some unknown means.

In any case, those are nothing more than unfounded speculations.
oathDesc: Providing guidance for a fallen star.

projections.name: Dark and Lonely World
projections.desc:
After transfiguration, a Doll's neural cloud takes on a brand new form, yet one that retains a hint of familiarity.
"The stars no longer shine in the sky, and all things return to silence... Is this not a wondrous sight?"

projections.desc:

"The stars no longer shine in the sky, and all things return to silence... Is this not a wondrous sight?"

projections.name: Splendor of the Void
projections.desc:
After transfiguration and evolving to a certain degree, a Doll's neural cloud takes on a form that silently hints at certain possibilities.
"From the depths of infinite solitude comes a silent heartbeat. The slumbering cosmos opens its eyes and emerges from its cocoon at the bottom of the abyss."

skinList.name: Sterling Gemini
skinList.desc:
In the vast and boundless cosmos, I read such a beautiful message: If thou art willing to take my hand, the stars and moon shall be ever so captivating.
"Even if everything is bound to end in oblivion, this oath I swear with you shall become the last sliver of light, forever abiding, even should the cosmos collapse."
